title: BioEmu-1: ensembles of protein structures with deep learning
summary: An open-source model that generates thousands of protein structures per hour on a GPU and reproduces the equilibrium distribution of a molecular-dynamics simulation using 10,000 to 100,000 times fewer GPU-hours. Predicted folding free energies correlate well with experimental values. The authors call it ‘a first step.’

evidence.tested: Generated ensembles were compared with a molecular dynamics simulation of protein G using 10,000 to 100,000 times fewer GPU hours, and predicted folding free energies were correlated with experimental values.
evidence.unknown: The authors state they are aware of limitations but the post does not list them, and it is presented as an early step.
evidence.ai_role: A generative deep learning model produces thousands of protein structures per hour on a GPU.
